is_fractional_chromatic.note: is_fractional_chromatic G r: r is the attained minimum of a/b over the (a:b)-colourings (GTBase b-fold colourings over the supplied palette 'I_a) with a positive denominator b, the standard fractional chromatic number of a finite graph as a relation; the value is unique and, for every finite graph, exists (LP attainment, Atlas.foundations.fractional.frac_chromatic_exists). No guard on G: the empty graph has value 0. Rows that need a non-empty graph carry their own guard.
